trigger.description: The bridge target exists but carries no ee:agentsmd managed block yet — an import-only file or the first export into a hand-written AGENTS.md. Export appends a fresh managed block at the end of the file (after backing the file up) and never touches the existing content; import parses the whole file; drift reports no managed-block status (ADR 0065 §6).
setup_commands:
printf '# AGENTS.md

- Always run the verify script before pushing changes.
' > AGENTS.md

notes: Informational by design: a file without markers is the normal starting state of the bridge. The first `ee export agentsmd` writes the markers; until then import treats every rule-like line as hand-written.
